name: gVisor
description: An application kernel that provides a strong isolation boundary for containers.
summary: gVisor welcomes the use of AI tools, but requires human oversight: AI-generated content must be reviewed by the contributor before submission, the contributor stays the sole author and is fully responsible for the work, and substantial AI-generated content must be labeled (for example with an Assisted-by trailer). These rules explicitly cover code changes, issues and security reports, and comments and feedback on pull requests or issues.

evidence.quote: While contributors can use any AI tools to create their contributions, human oversight is mandatory. All AI-generated content must be thoroughly reviewed by the contributor before being submitted for review.
